title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Settling Fuel at the End of a Hire
content:
The fuel arrangement is the rate class's own: a full-to-full class expects the vehicle back with a full tank, a same-to-same class expects it back at the level it left with, and a prepaid class sells the tank in advance at the class's own price per gallon. A fuel settlement is raised only while the rental record stands at picked up or returned. Where a full-to-full or same-to-same vehicle comes back short, the missing fuel is charged at the class's price per gallon and the class's refuelling service charge is added once. Where a prepaid class vehicle comes back with fuel still in it, nothing is returned, because the tank was sold and not lent. A renter who refuels at a filling station and keeps the receipt is charged nothing at all, whatever the class, provided the tank meets the class's expectation. The refuelling service charge is never charged twice on one rental, and never where the shortfall is less than a quarter of a gallon, being 0.25 of a gallon.

**The three arrangements set against one another.**

| Arrangement | What the class expects back | What a shortfall costs | What surplus fuel earns |
|---|---|---|---|
| Full to full | A full tank | The missing fuel at the class's price per gallon, and the refuelling service charge once | Nothing is provided for |
| Same to same | The level it left with | The missing fuel at the class's price per gallon, and the refuelling service charge once | Nothing is provided for |
| Prepaid | The tank was sold in advance at the class's price per gallon | | Nothing is returned, because the tank was sold and not lent |

**Basis questions on the Car Rental Rate Classes.**

*When may a fuel settlement be raised at all?* Only while the rental record stands at picked up or returned. The rental record is the authority for that, and it is read before the settlement is raised, against the rental the settlement belongs to. A rental standing at booked, confirmed, cancelled, recorded as a no-show or closed is not open for a fuel settlement.

*A renter refuelled on the way back and kept the receipt.* Nothing at all is charged, on any class, provided the tank meets the class's expectation.

*The vehicle is a few drops short.* Where the shortfall is less than 0.25 of a gallon, the refuelling service charge is not added. Where it is 0.25 of a gallon or more, the charge is added once and once only on that rental, however the shortfall arose.
